boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified, no-purchase activities at Florida Gulf Coast University, including outdoor spaces, recreation, performances, wellness outreach and public campus events.

cards.title: Wander the Food Forest
cards.subtitle: A free, community-accessible botanical garden beside Kleist Health Education Center
cards.notes: Walk among tropical and subtropical edible plants between sunrise and sunset, following the posted garden etiquette while you explore.
cards.short_summary: Explore a student-run edible landscape designed around permaculture, sustainability and whole-food education.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU identifies the Food Forest as a free resource for students and community members and says the garden is open from sunrise to sunset.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to students, employees and community members from sunrise to sunset; the site is university property.

cards.title: Drop Into a Group Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Student classes in the University Recreation & Wellness Center studios
cards.notes: Check the current schedule, choose a format such as yoga or cycling, and register through FGCU Go when booking opens 24 hours ahead.
cards.short_summary: Join a scheduled, instructor-led workout without paying a separate class charge.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU states that group fitness classes are free for currently enrolled students, are drop-in, and offer registration 24 hours in advance.
cards.access_notes: Free for currently enrolled FGCU students; consult the current schedule and use FGCU Go for advance registration.

cards.title: Meet Up for an Open Swim
cards.subtitle: Student swimming at the campus Aquatics Center
cards.notes: Review open-swim and lane availability before walking over, then bring your Eagle ID and adjust plans if lightning closes the pool.
cards.short_summary: Use a free student recreation benefit for lap swimming or a low-key pool meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says graduate students enjoy free access to its aquatics center, while the recreation site publishes current open-swim periods.
cards.access_notes: Free student access is documented by FGCU; bring an Eagle ID and confirm current open-swim hours and weather status.

cards.title: Plan a No-Cost Workout
cards.subtitle: Student fitness access inside FGCU’s recreation center
cards.notes: Meet at the recreation center for a self-directed workout, carrying your Eagle ID and checking facility hours before setting out.
cards.short_summary: Turn the campus fitness center into an easy, purchase-free meetup for enrolled students.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU’s graduate-student resource page explicitly lists free access to the university fitness center.
cards.access_notes: Free access is documented for FGCU graduate students; entry requires applicable student eligibility and an Eagle ID.

cards.title: Take a Campus Nature Walk
cards.subtitle: No-fee trails through FGCU’s preserved native habitats
cards.notes: Choose daylight and comfortable walking shoes, follow marked routes, and pause to observe the native habitat without disturbing wildlife.
cards.short_summary: Walk FGCU’s nature trails together while seeing the campus’s preserved South Florida landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU states that graduate students receive free access to campus nature trails and describes its preservation of native habitats.
cards.access_notes: FGCU documents free student access; use marked trails during appropriate campus-access periods and observe posted conditions.

cards.title: Spend an Afternoon at the Waterfront
cards.subtitle: Student recreation beside Lake Como in North Lake Village
cards.notes: Check the Waterfront’s operating status first, bring your Eagle ID, and choose only staffed activities available during your visit.
cards.short_summary: Gather beside FGCU’s freshwater lake for university-operated waterfront recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says Waterfront activities at its 80-acre freshwater lake are free of charge for students.
cards.access_notes: Activities are free for FGCU students; the Waterfront is not for public use, and availability depends on posted hours, staffing and weather.

cards.title: Hear a Student Recital
cards.subtitle: Free performances in U. Tobe Recital Hall
cards.notes: Pick a recital from the published calendar and arrive at U. Tobe Recital Hall with enough time to find seating before the performance.
cards.short_summary: Listen to FGCU student musicians perform in a formal campus recital without needing a ticket.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU states that all student recitals are free, open to the public and do not require tickets.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public with no ticket required; attend only a recital listed on the current university calendar.

cards.title: Browse the Eagle X Showcase
cards.subtitle: FGCU’s annual public exhibition of student projects
cards.notes: Use the event page to confirm the next date, then circulate among research, internship, leadership and community-engagement displays.
cards.short_summary: See student projects from across campus at FGCU’s free annual showcase.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU describes Eagle X as an annual student-project showcase that is always free and open to the community.
cards.access_notes: Always free and open to the community; the university lists the next event for April 16, 2027 and advises checking back for details.

cards.title: Catch a URecWell Ride
cards.subtitle: Free student rides to destinations around campus
cards.notes: Watch for the yellow URecWell golf cart on its periodic campus rounds, flag it down, and join the short wellness conversation en route.
cards.short_summary: Turn a trip across campus into a brief, free wellness-learning activity.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says URecWell Rides gives students free transportation to any campus location and explicitly states that all rides are free.
cards.access_notes: Free for students when the yellow outreach cart is operating; service runs randomly several times per month and is not on demand.

cards.title: Try a Wellness Wednesday Activity
cards.subtitle: A weekly student outreach table with a rotating game or activity
cards.notes: Check Eagle Link for that week’s location, then stop between classes for the featured activity and practical wellness information.
cards.short_summary: Join a brief campus wellness activity designed to fit between classes without requiring a purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: FGCU says each Wellness Wednesday includes a wellness topic, a corresponding game or activity, prizes and other freebies for students.
cards.access_notes: No purchase or admission is described; student outreach is scheduled Wednesdays from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., with location posted in Eagle Link.

warnings: Several recreation cards are student-only and require current FGCU eligibility or an Eagle ID; public access is stated only where the cited source confirms it.
Activity schedules, facility status and weather closures can change; users should consult the linked official pages before visiting.
